name: Ragi Porridge
steps: Whisk ragi flour into 250 ml cold water until completely smooth; this prevents lumps.
Heat the remaining 200 ml water with milk in a heavy saucepan. Pour in the ragi slurry while whisking continuously.
Cook over low-medium heat for 8–10 minutes, stirring and scraping the base, until the raw flour taste disappears and the porridge thickens.
Turn off the heat. Stir in jaggery and cardamom until dissolved; divide into four bowls and garnish with chopped almonds.
tips: Add jaggery only after switching off the heat to keep the milk smooth.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
